request.style: English, warm female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light percussion, hopeful and triumphant mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
May He remember all your offerings
Receive your burnt offering with favor
Give you what your heart desires
Bring all your plans to pass

[Verse]
We shout for joy at your victory
Raise our banners in the name of our God
The LORD fulfills every request
Your plans in His hands are held

[Chorus]
Now I know the LORD saves his anointed
He answers from his holy heaven
With the saving power of his right hand
We call on the name of the LORD our God

[Verse]
Some trust in chariots and some in horses
But we call on the name of the LORD
They are brought to their knees and fall
But we rise up and stand firm

[Chorus]
Now I know the LORD saves his anointed
He answers from his holy heaven
With the saving power of his right hand
We call on the name of the LORD our God

[Outro]
They fall, but we rise up
Standing firm in the name of the LORD
